newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipino policeman shot, chopped to pieces, burnt.
newsitem.headline: Filipino policeman shot, chopped to pieces, burnt.

text.p: Philippine police were searching on Tuesday for the missing head of a police sergeant whose mistress is accused of hacking his body to pieces and scattering the parts around Manila.
"We have found parts of his spinal column and some of his bones but we don't have the head yet," investigator Captain Edwin Rigor told reporters.
Sergeant Benuel Rosello was shot dead more than two weeks ago but police learnt of it only on Monday when they went to his house to find out why he had not been reporting for duty, Rigor said.
A houseboy told police that Rosello's live-in partner had killed him.
The servant said he saw her chop up his body with a machete and that he then helped her throw away the pieces after first trying to burn them.
The woman has been detained but refuses to make a statement, Rigor said.
"Jealousy is one angle we're at looking at. We will book her for murder," he said.
